method: Built-in image generation; illustrative covers only

projects.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one premium landscape developer portfolio project cover image for 'Veyro' (spell V-e-y-r-o), a social media web application. This is a polished illustrative concept cover, not an actual screenshot. Wide 16:10 composition, clean editorial product design, warm off-white and muted lavender social feed interface with a small sidebar, understated avatar circles and a large abstract editorial post. One elegant floating browser window, nearly front-on, fully inside the image with generous safe margins. Restrained charcoal typography, warm orange accent details matching a charcoal-and-terracotta developer portfolio, soft studio lighting, subtle depth and crisp edges. Include only the clearly readable app name 'Veyro', short UI labels 'Feed', 'Explore', 'Messages', and small 'Concept preview' text in a quiet lower corner. Do not invent stats, claims, photos of real people, notifications, testimonials, extra device mockups, stock-photo watermarks, or a portfolio website around this image. This image itself is the card's project artwork. High quality refined modern interface presentation, not a busy collage.
